item.title: Unique experiences to treat the mums in your life to this Mother’s Day – Bolton Council
item.description: Bolton’s award winning Food and Drink Festival is gearing up for another unforgettable year - and just in time for Mother’s Day, one of its most popular ticketed events has officially gone on sale.

item.title: New bus services hailed by council – Bolton Council
item.description: New bus services are set to link Bolton town centre with Middlebrook for the first time and make getting to and from Logistics North easier for people who work there.

item.title: Crompton Place developers set out vision for Bolton’s future – Bolton Council
item.description: More than 200 representatives from local businesses heard how the redevelopment of Crompton Place marks an exciting new phase in Bolton’s regeneration.

item.title: Homecoming for Bolton’s iconic elephants – Bolton Council
item.description: Bolton’s iconic elephants will make a triumphant return as the council aims to guarantee everyone a warm welcome to the town centre.

item.title: Bolton launches the 2040 Vision – Bolton Council
item.description: The Bolton Vision Partnership has officially launched the Bolton 2040 Vision (The Borough Plan), a roadmap to transform the community into one where everybody can thrive.

item.title: Bolton’s Sleeper Pod scheme judged a success – Bolton Council
item.description: As Bolton’s Sleeper Pod test draws to an end, its former homeless residents have praised the life-changing opportunities it provided them.

item.title: New Youth MPs announced for Bolton – Bolton Council
item.description: Bolton’s new Youth MPs have been elected after young people across Bolton cast their vote for candidates at the Youth MP Elections 2026.

item.title: Council’s employment support service relocates ahead of Crompton Place redevelopment – Bolton Council
item.description: Bolton Council’s employment support services has relocated to the One Stop Shop as work progresses on the demolition and redevelopment of Crompton Place.

item.title: Security improvements planned for popular Halliwell park – Bolton Council
item.description: Persistent anti-social concerns at Rawsthorne Park in Halliwell have prompted a joint response from local partners determined to improve safety and restore confidence in the space.

item.title: Crompton Place demolition to bring apprenticeships and £1m local spend – Bolton Council
item.description: The demolition of Crompton Place will deliver immediate benefits for Bolton, including new apprenticeships and a £1m contribution to the local economy.

item.title: Town centre bridge gets a spring clean – Bolton Council
item.description: Bolton’s landmark bridge is looking good as new after the council gave it a thorough spring clean.

item.title: Bolton Legends Foster campaign aims to inspire more foster carers – Bolton Council
item.description: Bolton Council has launched a powerful new social media campaign, Bolton Legends Foster, shining a spotlight on the everyday heroes.

item.title: Queens Park’s famous fountain springs back to life – Bolton Council
item.description: The much-loved fountain in Bolton’s Queens Park sprung back to life this week following a major refurbishment as part of the largest investment into greenspace services.

item.title: Trading Standards seizes more than 200,000 illegal single use vapes in major operation – Bolton Council
item.description: Bolton Council’s Trading Standards team has seized 211,606 illegal single use vapes from a warehouse in the Halliwell area.

item.title: Active Bolton begins new chapter for leisure services across the borough – Bolton Council
item.description: Active Bolton has officially taken over the management of Bolton’s leisure centres, marking the start of a new chapter for community health, fitness and wellbeing across the borough.
